note: Small rural campground beside a pond at 492 County Road 100 N, Montrose, a couple of miles off I-70, with level gravel sites, a pavilion and a playground. The operator's only web presence is Facebook; call or just pick an open site. --Claude
summary: Facebook header, Campendium (16 reviews, 2024-25 rates), Google, imagery read. $25 a night (reported 9/2025), far under the gate; Google 4.7/123; nightly-use park (pick a site, pay at the door) - passes the long-stay tests. Hookups: water hookups exist at a few sites (stored water false corrected). Not waterfront kept (site positions unknown; shower house and pavilion stand between the loop and pond).
flags: PRICE: $25 a night from camper reports (latest 2025-09-12 on Campendium; RV Life Aug 2026 per the stored note) - operator posts no rate; Facebook-only, so camper reports are the allowed source. Under the $50 gate; no gateway within 40 km, not Good Sam (irrelevant at $25).
GOOGLE: Springcreek Campground 4.7 (123 reviews), phone 217-821-2181 (matches stored). RV Life 4* (stored). Facebook: 1,859 followers.

LONG-STAY TESTS: nightly guests are the business - every 2024-25 report is a one- or few-night stop paying $25 a night, sites are picked on arrival, 'only a couple other campers'. No seasonal/monthly offer seen on any readable page (Facebook posts unread). Passes; not mostly seasonal.
WEBSITE: https://facebook.com/260149347506776/ -> https://www.facebook.com/SpringCreekCampground/ (the old id URL redirects there).

ADDRESS: Campendium lists '81 County Rd 500 E (1 mile north of Montrose)'; Google gives 492 County Rd 100 N - the note keeps Google's. Pin matches the campground loop (Campendium pin 39.185616,-88.379288, ~10 m).

WATERFRONT: kept not waterfront. Pond ~130 m long south of the loop; the shower house and pavilion stand on the lawn between the loop road and the north shore (~25-35 m). No site map or site numbers exist to place any pad on the water.
SEASON: Campendium tags it 'Open seasonally', but a 2024 reviewer stayed in November-December 2023 and March 2024; left unset.
UNREAD: Facebook posts and About details beyond the header (login wall; not routed around).
